international.title: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie settle years-long legal battle over joint French winery
international.summary: Pitt filed the lawsuit against Jolie in 2022 after she sold her stake in Château Miraval, saying she broke their agreement not to sell their interests Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have settled a years-long legal battle over their French winery, according to a joint statement from the former Hollywood couple. “We have settled out of court in the best interests of our family and will not be commenting further,” representatives for Jolie and Pitt said in a statement. “Any comments in media stories attributed to ‘sources’ are in fact not coming from either of us, or anyone close to us.” Continue reading...
